items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Yeah, and then he had another brother named Pallet. He was a trombone player and he went to the bass.

ctx.x: Yes, I believe he told us about these Gabriel.

Yeah, and then he had another brother named Pallet. He was a trombone player and he went to the bass. Then he had another brother named Willie. Well, he played saxophone and clarinet. They all used to play with Joe Gabriel, but they had some kind of falling out and they organized the James brothers band out there in Tippet-Owe. And then from there I came down to New Orleans.
Well, how old were you when you got your trombone about?
